system.description:
You were created, not born, and your abilities simply stem from your makeup.

Powers

Assign all the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to any of the following powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.KaCyS15sdeKfi3g1]{Inventions}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.kQBxHAqBwDrh07qB]{Robotics}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Elemental/Energy powers category

• Select from Intellectual powers category

• Select from Mobility powers category

• Select from Self Control powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.lnLDxlGSgYHnyn4k]{Created Immunity}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.ARWVQAsAH51XPtSP]{Multiple Assault}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.6AoOtIbrr9DlJqZq]{Recalculating...}

Gain one of these Green abilities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.T8eKmRY72OBHNMl2]{Created Form}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.Fyzx36w6FQSgnaUP]{Intentionality}
Archetype

Roll d10, d8, d8 for archetype selection.
